title: Ramp customer wall
description: A two-tone social-proof line with a 'read more' arrow link, then a wall of square hairline tiles holding grey customer wordmarks (six by two on desktop, three across on phones) beside a tall photo card with a big white stat. Tiles fade in one after another as the wall scrolls into view; linked tiles carry a small round arrow chip.
notes: the stat card's photo is a media slot; empty, it shows a grey-to-ink gradient so the white stat stays readable
the staggered fade is a CSS scroll-driven animation; browsers without it show every tile
